paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing eps (paper's epsilon, not eps^2)
notes: SuperCDMS Soudan sets 90% CL upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing eps (and separately on ALP axioelectric coupling g_ae) via dark absorption in Ge detectors, assuming the candidate is all of galactic DM with rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3. Mass range covered: 40 eV to 500 keV. Full exclusion curves are only shown in figures (Figs. 10/13, corrected version); no numerical table is provided. The only explicit numerical value in the text is eps < ~1e-15 near 100 eV/c^2, emitted as a single data point. Limits are 'world leading or competitive' for 40-186 eV. The paper equally constrains AxionElectron (g_ae < ~1e-12 at few-hundred eV); DarkPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint.
